title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn | TechCrunch
summary: Nvidia is run with a famously flat structure, with more than 60 direct reports to Huang, and the company doesn’t appear to have a succession plan, which Lipton called “a danger for any company.” Huang’s children also work at Nvidia.
